posts.subject: Fiddles' Staff Application
posts.bodyHtml:
0) Do I meet the requirements?


Yes, I am of 16 years of age, and play rather regularly on the SurfDM server on CSGO. I have much enjoyed my time playing on the server. I have many Stamm and rank points. For stamm, I have around 3400 points.I have 2993 rank points. I own a headset as well as teamspeak 3. I speak english as it is my first language. Slowly, I am trying to remember German; but these are just phrases to help with translation. As well as being good at speaking english, I am that of being assertive as well as having a high regard of maturity. As seen from the paragraph I have typed, you can probably guess my language style for which I also speak. Admins I shall respect as they always are the good guys when you need them the most, and I have to respect them on that. Loyalty will be kept along with the fondness of respect for the admins.
_______________________________


1) What is your name? Real & Ingame: My real name is Finley, my ingame name is Fiddles.


2) How old are you? I am 16 years of age.


3) Why do you want to join our administrative team? I want to join the administration team as I think I can help when some admins are not on at the time. Which for me is quite common and during that time, many rule breakers are just ruining my experience. For which I presume will be the same for much of the lower leveled people on the server as they would not stand a chance and have a negative impact on their score. Here I will be swift, stern and very polite mannered until they start being mean or stupid. With this the "mighty wrath of Fiddles", as told by other GMOD communities I staffed for, will dessimate on those who go awry from the path of following the rules.


4) How long have you been playing on our servers? I am not sure on the exact timeframe for which I have been playing on the SurfDM server. However, if a stamm point is awarded each minute; I should have been playing for 56 hours (approximately). I have played about 30 minutes on the TTT CSGO server, also.


5) What are your favourite hobbies or pastimes? My favourite hobbie is to do some graphic design, usually to be able to make my level of skill a bit better. People have even asked me to do some logo design for them and even payed me. Currently, I am working on designing different CSGO skins using the 3D model feature of Photoshop CC. Most of my designs are saved. Other than that, I watch films and shows I do not usually see on time, listen to some metal, play CSGO with a friend from school, enjoy other games in my steam library, continue my online course for a GCSE in computer science and also do some homework/revision for school.


6) Do you think of yourself as mature? Yes, very much so.


7) Have you gained experience as an administrator before? Yes, I have been doing staff work since I was twelve. Although, this was for GMOD which does run on a similar engine. These were all for DarkRP servers. They were called: BluesheepRP, Harry's Mod, Nightstar Gaming, CyberRP and GoodGamers. Each of these I had acquired the highest rank of super admin. Although, it took me some time to achieve that due to the staff application quota which had to be met (*cough* nearly 1000 hours on GMOD *cough*). I very much so enjoyed the experience of being a staff member to a server.


[8)] When do you play? (timetable of your average week)
Okay so each day I get back from school at 14:40 GMT. From then I am on my PC until 22:00 GMT. Here I could be playing any sort of game, but I currently have CSGO with the highest frequency of sessions when playing. Usual times for me to play CSGO is after 18:00 GMT. I would want to present some well formatted table, chart or detailed description but it is simply this.


9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take? At first I tell him to stop, usually I would enact a warn on user 1 if a warns system was available. However, if he pursues with any more insult I will just kick him. This is due to him insulting other players as well as ignoring a staff's command. If he were to join back and continue he would get a ban with a length dependable on the assertiveness and frequency of the certain insult(s). Furthermore, I would reassure that user 2 is not a "cunt" and to apologise to him for what has happened but to also wish him a good day/evening.


10) Strengths: I am very good at science (for my age). I have a weird tendency to have vigilance which I seem to keep using to make a plot trail about someone. For example, if someone were to do something I would infer the actual reasons as to why they were doing that. This helps further a staff situation if they become subject to any accusation. Here I can develop a small profile of that person within my head, this also is done with what I ask them so that more inferences can be made to develop the truth as to what they were saying. I am also rather swift in dealing with things. If I were to warn someone for something and they were to even the slightest do that again, they would get punished instantly. This is because they have already been warned but are also going to waste my time in the future which could be used when helping other players or conversing with victims of wrongdoing on teamspeak.


11) Weaknesses: I am prone to falling asleep a lot, this is a weird issue but never usually interrupts my PC time. I am rather much a slow typer as I have a slightly bottom of average typing speed. Another weakness that I currently am trying to fix is that I do not know a lot of German. As said before, I have just learnt phrases with help further translation.


12) Conclusion / Closing remark: Overall, I am someone who is always at his PC in his spare time and has quite an extensive staff background. I do hope that any decisions made about me are just and do not affect my current position within the community negatively.


Thank you for reading my application,


Kindest Regards,



Fiddles 😄
Objectively , the application is very good . Although I have not read the application completely through but why not . I say YES .

Hey Fiddles,
as Kamikaze said, your application is really good. I really liked the length of it and how extensive it was. Since you're an native English speaker, your language skills were on point and that is obviously an advantage for you.
Nonetheless I have two minor "complaints".


Zitat von Fiddles

Furthermore, I would reassure that user 2 is not a "cunt" and to apologise to him for what has happened but to also wish him a good day/evening.

That would be noble from you but at the same time, it's completely unnecessary. You don't need to apologize, since it's not your fault and you are also not the one insulting him.


Zitat von Fiddles

10) Strengths: I am also rather swift in dealing with things. If I were to warn someone for something and they were to even the slightest do that again, they would get punished instantly.

I'm not sure how that could be considered a strength. Personally, I would rather see it as a weakness. Although I have never played with you before (that's because I don't play on SurfDM), this is my biggest concern with you. Based on your application, I kind of get the feeling that you could be the type of admin that may overreact in certain situations and ban people too fast. It is hard to say because I don't know you at all, but still, that is only concern with your application.


All in all, I'm going to give you a Yes. Good luck with your application 🙂
